civic_parapet_reconciliation.ruling_honoured: civic_parapet is the WALL-FACE fascia overlay; this ring is the ROOF-PLANE coping top (125-138) + 6px outer sliver (115-125) that its fascia continues. Complementary, not rival. WIRING NOTE: a renderer stacking both must not double-cap.

wang16.contract: field = all-neighbours-filled centre; ring = 4 outside corners, 4 runs x2 wear variants, 4 INSIDE corners (built first), 3 ends, + scupper. Closes a rectangle AND an L (proofs P06/P07).

wang16.mitre_compromise: 1px band (~10 lum) where the S outer sliver turns the inside/outside S corners — declared, not hidden.
